name: Blockscout API v2 (eth.blockscout.com)
operator: Blockscout (Blockscout Ltd., open-source explorer, hosted instances)
tier_rationale: Open-source explorer project with an identifiable operator, public API documentation and a multi-year track record (A8 community). Tiers: Etherscan, OKLink, PublicNode trusted; Blockscout, Ethplorer community.

reliability.justification: Explorer API over Ethereum mainnet: balances and transactions are chain facts; is_scam flags and public tags are curated labels (leads, named as Blockscout's).

api_v2.title: Blockscout REST API v2: /addresses/{a}, /addresses/{a}/transactions, /addresses/{a}/token-balances, /addresses/{a}/counters, /search?q=

terms.quote: Per-adapter classes (A1 BR3): Blockscout keyless and PublicNode RPC 'open' (free public APIs, terms recorded, as in P205 and P211); Etherscan, Ethplorer and OKLink 'key-terms' (company keys on recorded plans).

api_v2.notes: Quote: binding council text (P212 cond 5). Research C0473 (verified_live 200): keyless; is_scam, reputation, public_tags/metadata.tags, ens_domain_name, creator_address_hash; /search?q=name.eth resolves ENS names; next_page_params paging. Prep live check 2026-11-26: x-ratelimit-limit 180, unknown address -> HTTP 200 with null balance/creation fields (not 404); the address endpoint of a heavy address hung > 20 s (5 s timeout, fail over). Used by evm_explorers (first adapter).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G09-2 (P212). Keyless hosted instance (x-ratelimit-limit 180 per window observed): 0.5 s politeness, crypto ttl 1 h, 5 s timeout. Other Blockscout instances (base, optimism, gnosis...) need their own host entry and verification before use.
